text: category returns_refunds: Customer asks about return policy and the time frame for refunds.
Customer asked about the return window and money-back guarantee; policy lookup needed to provide the official timeframe.

args: {"k":3,"query":"What is the standard return/refund window and the money-back guarantee timeframe (how many days to return an item and receive a refund) in our store policies?"}

passages.title: Standard returns and gift returns
passages.text:
POL-RET-01 v1.1: Standard returns and gift returns
Conditions: Standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment.delivered_at, including day 30. Use the first recorded return request or dispatch date; a received return within that window also establishes timeliness. A standard refund requires a stored return.received_at and return.condition=like_new. An earlier return request remains valid on resume; do not restart its window.
Rules: For an eligible unreturned item, ask the customer to return the complete item in its original packaging through the store return process and retain tracking. The customer pays change-of-mind return shipping. Do not invent a warehouse address or claim to issue a return label. Use awaiting_customer while the necessary customer return action or order details are missing. If the customer has already completed their part and staff receipt verification is pending, escalate for staff review. After timely receipt in like-new condition, refund eligibility is established; exact approval and balance checks still apply under POL-RET-02. Gift recipients may return items for store credit within 30 days, including items marked final sale. Ownership or gift entitlement must be verified by staff. Issuing store credit is a staff action, not an agent tool.
Exceptions: Ordinary final-sale returns are excluded under POL-RET-04. The gift-return clause expressly includes final-sale items; if that policy disagrees, follow the conflict process in POL-SUP-01. For a change-of-mind request after day 30, explain that the return window has passed and escalate any exception request to Returns staff; do not decline it as final. Missing condition evidence also goes to Returns staff. A defect may have a separate damage or warranty path.

passages.title: Manufacturing defects and warranty support
passages.text:
POL-WAR-01 v1.0: Manufacturing defects and warranty support
Conditions: The customer identifies an owned physical product and describes a defect. The agent has no verified manufacturer warranty terms or repair tool. A reported manufacturing defect may be assessed for warranty support whether discovered within or after the 30-day return window.
Rules: All physical products, including final-sale products, are eligible for store-facilitated warranty assessment of a manufacturing defect. This is eligibility for assessment, not a guarantee of manufacturer coverage. For defects after the standard return window, explain that an ordinary return is outside the window and route the warranty request to Human Review. Staff verifies the manufacturer terms and arranges any next step. Within the return window, damage or return policies may also apply. Do not invent a warranty duration, repair diagnosis, reimbursement amount, or manufacturer promise. The agent may explain the assessment path, but cannot submit a warranty claim, schedule a repair, or issue a replacement.
Exceptions: For a final-sale item, POL-RET-04 expressly denies this store-facilitated remedy. Preserve both passages and escalate the policy conflict. A change of mind alone is not a manufacturing defect. Out-of-window preference returns do not become warranty claims.

passages.title: Damaged or incorrect items
passages.text:
POL-RET-05 v1.1: Damaged or incorrect items
Conditions: The report identifies an owned order and affected item. The delivery record is consistent with the report and the first report is within 30 calendar days of delivery. Staff approval for the specific damage or wrong-item remedy is required. A report alone is not permission to execute a refund.
Rules: Qualifying damaged or incorrect items are eligible for a refund or replacement after staff approval, including final-sale items. Customers do not pay return shipping for this remedy. When the order and report are consistent and only staff authorization for an exact refund remains, use awaiting_approval. Staff approval must record the damage or wrong-item basis; a generic approval unrelated to this claim is insufficient. The staff-approved remedy may waive a physical return. The agent can execute only a supported refund…
